retail_centres: Caulfield Major Activity Centre — 122 hectares bounded by Dandenong and Balaclava Roads, Kambrook and Booran Roads, Neerim Road and Queens Avenue/Grange Road; identified as a Major Activity Centre in Plan Melbourne 2017-2050 and the highest-order centre within Glen Eira [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]

Nine defined precincts within the Caulfield MAC: Derby Road, Village East, Village West, Kambrook and Booran Road, Neerim Road, Grange Road, Caulfield Station, Racecourse Reserve and Campus [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]

Caulfield Village mixed-use development beside the Racecourse Reserve and rail corridor — current stages include a major anchor supermarket, associated retail tenancies and limited commercial space [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]

Caulfield Plaza Shopping Centre on Dandenong Road (approx 15 stores, two anchor tenants), owned by Monash University — located in adjoining Caulfield East [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caulfield_East]
Glen Huntly Road runs along the southern boundary of the suburb of Caulfield [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caulfield,_Victoria]
office_or_business_precincts: Glen Eira notes the Caulfield MAC 'lacks major economic anchors within private industry' and is not an established private-sector office location, but has the labour force, transport accessibility and state-significant education precinct to support commercial floorspace expansion [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]

Sir John Monash Drive site identified for a mix of uses including commercial floorplates, hotel uses and ground-level hospitality tenancies [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]
institutions: Caulfield Hospital, Kooyong Road, Caulfield — managed by Alfred Health, focused on rehabilitation, aged care, brain injury and amputee rehabilitation, and aged mental health [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caulfield_Hospital]
Caulfield Hospital is a major landmark of the suburb [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caulfield,_Victoria]

Monash University Caulfield campus — identified as a State Significant Education Precinct and forming the Campus Precinct of the Caulfield MAC; located in adjoining Caulfield East [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]

Caulfield Racecourse Reserve, run by the Melbourne Racing Club — a state and regionally significant destination within the Caulfield MAC; located in adjoining Caulfield East [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]
Glenhuntly tram depot, an operating Melbourne tram depot and a major landmark of the suburb [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caulfield,_Victoria]
Caulfield Primary School, which runs a bilingual English-Japanese program [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caulfield,_Victoria]
Glen Eira College, in the south of the Caulfield activity centre [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]
hospitality_strips: Derby Road, identified in the structure plan for increased on-street outdoor dining and shopping, with an active street at night and outdoor dining areas supporting restaurants [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]

Caulfield Village bars, cafes and shops, supported by major events and gatherings at the Caulfield Racecourse Reserve [source: https://www.gleneira.vic.gov.au/media/files/Caulfield-Major-Activity-Centre-Structure-Plan.pdf]
commercial_anchors.commercial_summary: The suburb of Caulfield itself is small (1.5 sq km, 5,748 residents at the 2021 census) but it sits inside the 122-hectare Caulfield Major Activity Centre, the highest-order centre in the City of Glen Eira, which Glen Eira has divided into nine precincts including Derby Road, Caulfield Station, Racecourse Reserve and Campus. Premises that generate commercial cleaning demand are dominated by institutions and hospitality rather than offices: Caulfield Hospital on Kooyong Road (Alfred Health rehabilitation and aged care), the Glenhuntly tram depot, the Monash University Caulfield campus and Caulfield Racecourse Reserve just over the boundary in Caulfield East, plus the Derby Road dining strip and the retail and supermarket tenancies being built at Caulfield Village. Glen Eira's own structure plan notes the centre is not an established private-sector office location and lacks major private-industry anchors.
